description: After explicit organizer confirmation, setMember (existing verified account email/memberUid, role editor/reviewer/publisher/viewer, active, expectedRevision), setPolicy (requireReview, expectedRevision), or decideReview (reviewId, exact reviewHash, expectedDecisionRevision, decision approved/changes_requested). Explain that members gain audience/content/report access, publishers may send, and policy changes govern new approvals. A separate reviewer is required for authored work. Owner-only membership/policy changes; no invitation messages are sent. Workflow guide (MCP resource): socialloop://guides/email-campaigns.

confirmed.description: True only after the organizer approves the exact reviewed action.

payload.description: Action parameters used by the web workspace: IDs, expectedRevision, draft/definition, cursor, and reviewHash where required. Identity is supplied by the connected account.
